contract: design/quick-specs/modern-ui-2026-11-03.md: full-workspace map; real chapter, march and target HUD; charcoal, white and cinnabar; 44px actions; unchanged game state and ordinary confirmations

accessibility.evidence: Actual Tab/Shift+Tab focus has a visible solid outline and Enter opens the gift dialog. New HUD buttons and route summary measure at least 44px in all targets. Primary text #fff5ef on #bb4639 is 4.83:1; secondary #a9b5c1 on #18222d is 7.71:1. Reduced-motion mode used; no decorative animation introduced.

responsive.evidence: Four real viewports have no document horizontal overflow. The world remains square and is cropped by its viewport rather than stretched; map drag works and clicking the actual capital enters the city. Details expand and existing navigation, heroes and dispatch remain usable.

loading.reason: The changed HUD synchronously projects the existing local engine. It adds no asynchronous data loader; the actual fresh founding and opening sequence were tested.

empty.evidence: A fresh game opens military with no unlocked tasks, displays the unlock conditions and a current-objective action; that action really opens the existing objective dialog.

error.evidence: A legitimately earned army is reduced to zero in the actual dispatch form; the start action becomes disabled with its real reason. Entering thirty owned archers restores eligibility.

partial.evidence: Fresh target intelligence remains unknown and scouting is disabled without scouts; unavailable chapter stages remain disabled. No hidden enemy counts are displayed.

success.evidence: Keyboard Enter opens the real starter-gift dialog; confirming the real first gift sets its once-only claim. The legitimate first-victory save also opens ordinary chapter and dispatch screens.

permission.evidence: A second page in the same browser context loads the same live save while its writer remains open, displays the actual readonly/save-management boundary and its recovery actions; no takeover is performed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Modern phone map, chapter HUD, real target actions and five-way dock.
Full-height square world cropped to phone; capital and first field remain in view.
Wide map, compact left chapter rail, right target panel and command dock.
Short landscape keeps the target and primary actions inside the workspace.
City lots use dark planning cells and remove repeated empty-cell labels while keeping accessible names.
Larger real portraits, clear stats and horizontal hero actions.
Actual unit, commander and route controls in the unified modal.
Real second-tab writer protection remains visible and readable.
The actual zero-army validation disables starting and explains the missing soldiers.
